Hello Jack,

This is the final rate we are able to offer you. Unfortunately, we are unable to reduce it further.

Kindly also note that a security deposit of AED 2,000 is applicable.

Monthly rates are as follows:

August: AED 13,000

Thank you for your understanding, and please feel free to reach out if you have any questions.
